synckit DRAFT PR opened: https://github.com/yasyf/synckit/pull/4 (head cc-sync/artifact-delivery @ 6a26bc7, base main). Body written by the codex/astra prose lane (4720 chars; components, transfer limits, measured CommitBatch cost, testing checklist, release plan, draft caveat). CI all green on 6a26bc7:
- test 3m14s
- lint 44s
- vuln 41s
- guides/pr-check pass
- Socket Security pass
The final whole-diff review fixes (lens 0: 9 findings, lens 1: 8, overlapping on a batch.go:469 blocker) and docs will push onto this PR, and each push re-runs CI.
Flag for the post-fix check: the PR's measured MaxBatchObjects commit is 1m42.3s for 16384 objects vs 24.7s measured on the delta branch before the merge. That is still far under DispatchTimeout (10 min), but the reconciliation (Open dir sync / merged durability path) apparently reintroduced per-object cost. The coordinator will have it re-measured and explained or fixed after the fix stage.
The synckit in-process delivery harness for the E2E is complete (cc-sync/synckit-harness @ f0e2ef3, from ea6d2df); it merges into the synckit final after the fix stage.
